subject: Reorg merit pool re-balance & targeted retention approvals
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merit pool re-balance request for reorg-impacted ICs

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, the reorg that moved two pods under Jonas has left a handful of individual contributors (ICs) whose comp band positioning is now materially out of range. We took an initial look at the current merit pool and, given headcount changes and our midyear allocation, I recommend a targeted re-balance to cover:

- Up to 4 ICs for a one-time retention bonus (range: $10k–$25k)
- Up to 3 ICs for accelerated equity refresh grants (small RSU top-ups)

Attached is the impacted list with suggested amounts and rationale (comp_impacted_list.xlsx). High level asks:

1) Leadership sign-off to move $125k from the org-level discretionary merit pool into a targeted retention bucket.
2) Approval to submit equity refresh exceptions for the three cases flagged.
3) Confirmation we can bypass the normal 60-day hiring/comp freeze for these targeted one-offs due to business-critical continuity risk.

Notes: these are narrow, time-boxed, and intended to avoid talent loss during the transition. If we get green light, Marissa please route to PeopleOps/Payroll and copy Elena at Mercer for benchmarking confirmation.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: comp_impacted_list.xlsx (spreadsheet — 1 sheet)
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit pool re-balance request for reorg-impacted ICs

Laura —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the spreadsheet. Quick questions from my side before I sign off:

- Can you confirm these cases are all people who have direct retention risk (at least one counter-offer on the table or explicit search activity)?
- Do the equity refresh candidates require board approvals or are these within manager/comp committee authority?
- If we move $125k, does that leave other teams underfunded for planned midyear merit?

If answers are yes/clear, I support moving forward for the retention bonuses. For the equity refreshes I want clarity on approvals and any impact to run rate.

Jonas
VP, Platform Engineering

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit pool re-balance request for reorg-impacted ICs

All —

I reviewed the spreadsheet and ran high-level modeling. A few operational notes:

- The proposed $125k reallocation covers the recommended one-time cash retention offers and leaves ~20% of the org merit pool for the rest of the midyear program. We can tighten amounts if needed.
- Equity refreshes for the 3 ICs are technically exceptions but fall within our comp committee's delegated authority (no board sign-off required) — provided we document rationale and update the approval matrix.
- Payroll timing: any cash retention approved after Mar 15 will go into the April payroll; please confirm ASAP to meet the window.

Elena — can you confirm the benchmarks on the attached (I flagged 2 outliers where suggested top-ups exceed market 90th pct)? If Mercer recommends adjustments we should capture that in the approval memo.

Next steps suggested:
1) Jonas to confirm retention risk status (yes/no for each name).
2) Laura to ok the $125k move.
3) I will prepare approval_matrix.pdf with sign-off lines and route to PeopleOps and Finance (Aditya).

-Marissa
Head of Total Rewards

Attachment: approval_matrix.pdf (1 page — approval fields)
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit pool re-balance request for reorg-impacted ICs

Marissa/Laura —

Confirmed: all four flagged for retention have active recruiters talking to them and two have verbal interest from competitors. I recommend approving the one-time cash and moving forward with the equity refresh exceptions for the three engineers that are on cross-team critical projects.

Please proceed with the approval matrix; I'll sign once it's ready. Also prioritize including a short manager note for each person (one-sentence business rationale) in the approval packet — helps audit trail.

Jonas

Team —

Thanks — this is approved. Summary:

- $125,000 reallocated from discretionary merit pool into targeted retention bucket.
- One-time cash retention bonuses approved for 4 ICs (amounts per comp_impacted_list.xlsx).
- Equity refresh exceptions approved for the three engineers listed; Marissa to record in approval_matrix.pdf and send to PeopleOps for grant processing.
- Payroll note: Marissa/PeopleOps — please target April payroll for cash payments and include required manager notes.

Marissa — please route approval_matrix.pdf to Aditya for cost coding and to Elena for benchmarking confirmation. Once PeopleOps confirms, loop in legal if any paperwork needs special language.

Laura

Redwood Inference
